sentences.en: What snacks do you have today?
Some cheese and a few olives.
sentences.es: Un poco de queso y unas aceitunas.
sentences.pt: Um bocado de queijo e umas azeitonas.

sentences.en: Does a snack come free with the drink?
sentences.es: ¿La tapa va incluida con la bebida?
sentences.pt: O petisco vem incluído com a bebida?

sentences.en: I'd like to try something local.
sentences.es: Me gustaría probar algo de la zona.
sentences.pt: Gostava de provar algo da região.

sentences.en: Is it eaten hot or cold?
That was delicious, what was it called?
sentences.pt: Estava ótimo, como é que se chamava?

sentences.en: A glass of white wine, please.
sentences.es: Una copa de vino blanco, por favor.
sentences.pt: Um copo de vinho branco, por favor.

sentences.es: Una tabla de quesos para compartir.
sentences.pt: Uma tábua de queijos para partilhar.
Qual é o queijo mais forte?

sentences.en: Shall we go to another bar?

sentences.pt: Esta rodada é por minha conta.

sentences.en: Do you know a good place nearby?
sentences.pt: Conheces algum sítio bom aqui perto?

sentences.en: Just one more and then we'll go.
sentences.es: Tomamos una más y nos vamos.
sentences.pt: Bebemos só mais uma e vamos embora.

sentences.en: Is it too far to walk?
sentences.pt: É longe para ir a pé?

passages.text: En este bar, con cada caña ponemos una tapa gratis. Hoy hay mejillones o tortilla. Si quieren algo más, las raciones están en la pizarra.
passages.en: In this bar, every small beer comes with a free snack. Today there are two to choose from. If you want something else, the portions are on the board.
passages.question: What comes with each small beer?
wrong: A second beer at half price.
A free portion from the board.

passages.text: Neste bar, com cada imperial vem um petisco de oferta. Hoje há tremoços ou pão com chouriço. Se quiserem mais alguma coisa, as doses estão no quadro.
passages.en: In this bar, every small beer comes with a free snack. Today there are two to choose from. If you want something else, the portions are on the board.
passages.question: What comes with each small beer?
wrong: A second beer at half price.
A free portion from the board.

passages.text: Lo más típico aquí son los callos, pero si no le gustan las cosas fuertes, pruebe las croquetas caseras. Se comen calientes y son nuestra especialidad.
passages.en: The most typical dish here is a strong-tasting one, but if you don't like strong flavours, try the house speciality instead. It's eaten hot.
passages.question: What does the barman suggest if you don't like strong flavours?

passages.text: O mais típico aqui são as iscas, mas se não gosta de coisas fortes, prove os pastéis de bacalhau. Comem-se quentes e são a nossa especialidade.
passages.en: The most typical dish here is a strong-tasting one, but if you don't like strong flavours, try the house speciality instead. It's eaten hot.
passages.question: What does the barman suggest if you don't like strong flavours?

passages.text: Este blanco es de Rueda, seco y muy fresco. Si quiere, le pongo un poquito para probar antes. Con el queso curado le va mejor un tinto; este de Ribera es suave.
passages.en: This white is dry and very fresh. If you like, I'll pour you a little to taste first. With the aged cheese a red goes better; this one is smooth.
passages.question: What goes better with the aged cheese?

passages.text: Este branco é do Alentejo, seco e muito fresco. Se quiser, sirvo-lhe um bocadinho para provar primeiro. Com o queijo curado vai melhor um tinto; este do Douro é suave.
passages.en: This white is dry and very fresh. If you like, I'll pour you a little to taste first. With the aged cheese a red goes better; this one is smooth.
passages.question: What goes better with the aged cheese?

passages.text: Si queréis seguir, al final de la calle hay una taberna con música en directo hasta la una. Está a cinco minutos andando, pero los viernes se llena, así que id pronto.
passages.en: If you want to carry on, at the end of the street there's a tavern with live music until one. It's five minutes' walk, but on Fridays it fills up, so go early.
passages.question: Why should you go early?
wrong: It closes at one in the afternoon.

passages.text: Se quiserem continuar, no fim da rua há uma tasca com fado ao vivo até à uma. Fica a cinco minutos a pé, mas à sexta-feira enche, por isso vão cedo.
passages.en: If you want to carry on, at the end of the street there's a tavern with live music until one. It's five minutes' walk, but on Fridays it fills up, so go early.
